priority_contacts.name: Malcolm Maden
priority_contacts.institution: University of Florida, Department of Biology / UF Genetics Institute
priority_contacts.why: Corresponding author of the 29 July 2026 Acomys full-thickness skin study that provides the strongest spatial counterexample: dermal alpha-SMA state clears early while a panniculus-associated alpha-SMA bridge persists for weeks during successful regeneration.
ask: Whether the underlying alpha-SMA intensity measurements for each compartment and time point can be shared in machine-readable form.
Whether the panniculus bridge cells have lineage/fate data after alpha-SMA loss or during muscle replacement.
Whether the authors view compartment-specific persistence, rather than global myofibroblast duration, as a useful discriminator of regeneration versus fibrosis.

priority_contacts.name: Mark W. Majesky
priority_contacts.institution: University of Washington / Seattle Children's Research Institute
priority_contacts.why: Lead contact for the Acomys ear study where experimentally prolonging myofibroblast persistence by YAP-TEAD inhibition converted regeneration toward fibrosis, providing direct causal support for a resolution/fate gate.
ask: Whether quantitative myofibroblast abundance versus time can be shared beyond plotted figures.
Whether lineage fate after myofibroblast disappearance is known or can be inferred from existing data.
Whether spatial compartment and state transition are more informative than raw alpha-SMA persistence duration in their Acomys system.

priority_contacts.name: Zhigang He
priority_contacts.institution: Boston Children's Hospital / Harvard Medical School
priority_contacts.why: Corresponding author of neonatal spinal-cord scar-free repair study with unusually clean kinetics: Fn1 repair-state at 3 dpi not 5 dpi, bridge gone by 7 dpi, and causal microglia depletion/transplantation experiments.
ask: Whether lesion-level quantitative Fn1/fibronectin and P2Y12/SPP1/CD68 time-series values can be shared or reconstructed from source data.
Whether individual microglial cells were fate-tracked through activated-to-homeostatic transition versus replacement.
Whether adult persistent activation reflects the same state or a distinct trajectory from neonatal MG3.

priority_contacts.name: Alice H. Huang
priority_contacts.institution: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, Orthopaedics
priority_contacts.why: Corresponding author of neonatal tendon regeneration work defining transient alpha-SMA/fibrotic markers, intrinsic tenocyte recruitment and TGF-beta-dependent functional regeneration.
ask: Whether quantitative alpha-SMA cell abundance between day 3 and day 14 exists at intermediate time points.
Whether alpha-SMA helper cells are cleared, re-differentiate, or contribute to other lineages.
Whether adult versus neonatal wound-state trajectories can be compared on a normalized regeneration-loss time axis.

priority_contacts.name: Jeffery D. Molkentin
priority_contacts.institution: Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center / Heart Institute
priority_contacts.why: Corresponding author of cardiac fibroblast state-transition work demonstrating that alpha-SMA myofibroblasts are transient after adult MI even though mature scar persists, a decisive counterexample to the simple persistence model.
ask: Whether scar-maintaining post-myofibroblast states can be quantitatively mapped as a continuous lineage trajectory from days 3-28.
Whether profibrotic output duration or ECM-state memory is a better kinetic variable than alpha-SMA half-life.
Whether existing source data can support a normalized state-occupancy curve.

reason_for_first_contact: The July 2026 paper is the newest directly relevant result and independently reveals that long-lived myofibroblast persistence can be pro-regenerative when spatially routed, making it the cleanest test of the revised hypothesis.

message_positioning.do: Present this as a cross-tissue falsification exercise and a request for quantitative time-series/fate data.
do_not: claim discovery of a universal regeneration switch
claim their data prove LONGEVITY SURVIVOR
